results.title: The Case for Being Ungrateful: When Toxic Positivity Harms
results.description: This article examines the growing trend of gratitude practices, from journals to apps, while highlighting arguments from a Wall Street Journal column that suggests gratitude can become performative or toxic. It explores the concept of anti-gratitude journaling as a counter-movement to toxic positivity, which denies negative experiences, and questions whether forced thankfulness helps or hinders authentic emotional processing.
